body:
I have been taking 1200mg of Lithium for a month or two, but switched to XR 900mg last week. I take Risperidone 1mg at night and .25 during the day if needed for anxiety.
I went to a club and drank five shots of vodka after four beers. The next morning I was feeling horrible.
I went to a club and drank five shots of vodka after four beers. The next morning I was feeling horrible.
I'd never felt such an intense and painful hangover. I needed to study, though, so...
I took XR 10mg of Adderall which isn't much, but very quickly felt that something was wrong. My mind felt like it was going everywhere yet I couldn't sort out any thoughts. My body felt shivers all over and my bones were aching. I couldn't think strait, I was freaking out, my heart and stomach both decided to torture me.
I call my boyfriend who tells me to go take a cold shower. This was great advice. I freaked out in the shower some more but once I got out I felt considerably better. But not entirely. I needed to study so I tried, my head felt like it was about to explode. I would stare at random words, then at my hand then I'd twitch a lot.
I went for a walk. Like a paranoiac I was turning my head to everywhere around me, everything was majorly intriguing and terrifying. I attempted to sleep but my mind was still speeding. I constantly felt like I was about to have a seizure or fall and not be able to get up.
It was a horrible experience, of which, 24 hours later, I am still feeling the effects.
